paper_id: Systematic Literature Review of Commercial Participation in Open Source Software
title: Systematic Literature Review of Commercial Participation in Open Source Software
motivation: OSS商业参与研究分散缺系统性综述,学界业界仍凭经验而非系统架构交互
problem_framing: 商业参与OSS的动机、模式、影响未获系统梳理,定义RQ1-RQ4结构化研究问题
key_insight: 公司参与OSS动机分经济/技术/社会三类,参与模式反映社区交互方式,影响决定项目可持续性
method_signature: 基于Kitchenham指南的SLR,三数据库检索+滚雪球采样,内容分析92篇文献
evaluation_criteria: 统计发表趋势/ venue分布/方法类型,内容分析提取动机参与模式影响
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 指出当前研究分散且无系统架构,业界仍靠经验指导实践
evidence_for_taste: companies and OSS communities still use their empirical experience as a guide rather than a systematic architecture
Current studies on OSS are scattered and have different focuses
A comprehensive understanding...is still left as a knowledge gap
rich merchants from the cathedral, i.e. companies, have joined the development of OSS projects
thinking_moves: 将分散研究聚类为统一框架
用 cathedral-bazaar 隐喻重构公司-社区关系
按动机/模式/影响三维度结构化分析
从定性直觉转向证据驱动综述
